Definition: an enumeration; by implication, a valuation
BiblicalUsage: If the household is too little for the lamb, the neighbour next to the house shall take it according to the number of the souls, and the priest shall reckon the worth of the estimation unto the year of jubilee. The word is the counting itself, the enumeration, and it fixes what a man owes.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the counting as the measure of fairness: every man according to his eating, every estimation unto the jubilee, and no man asked for more than the number allows.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
